lines.trans: Good evening, dear guests of our restaurant!
Good evening, head chef!
I brought you a special surprise.
This is a compliment in honor of the birthday.
Thank you very much, everything looks very delicious!
I see that you are an excellent cook.
I can help you in the city.
Call me tomorrow at any time.
Thank you, this is a great honor for me!
Wait, I will taste the dish myself first.
Oh, the cook put way too much pepper in the sauce!
And in my opinion, it turned out quite delicious.
No, I will immediately redo everything!
I will personally bring you an ideal dish.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.text: Мы создадим идеальную команду для работы.
examples.trans: We will create an ideal team for work.

examples.text: Сегодня стояла идеальная погода для прогулки.
examples.trans: Today there was ideal weather for a walk.

meanings.en: complimentary gift from the house (in restaurants/services)

examples.text: Это небольшой комплимент от нашего заведения.
examples.trans: This is a small gift from our establishment.
He paid her a nice compliment.

examples.text: Аникеев лично сюда приезжал, и что?
examples.trans: Anikeev came here in person, and what?

meanings.note: в любой момент = at any moment

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
Today is a special day for us.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: to redo, to alter, to do over again

examples.trans: All of this needs to be redone.

переперчить.gloss: to over-pepper, put too much pepper

examples.trans: The cook put too much pepper in the sauce.

meanings.en: in my opinion, to my mind

examples.trans: In my opinion, this is disgusting!

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: всё получилось = it all worked out

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.
What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
The wind is blowing hard outside.
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Паста под соусом была очень вкусной.
examples.trans: The pasta with sauce was very tasty.
The chef prepared a spicy tomato sauce.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
Ваша честь = courtroom address to a judge

examples.text: Ваша честь, у нас есть заявление.
examples.trans: Your Honour, we have a statement.
It is a matter of honour.

meanings.en: executive chef, head of a kitchen

examples.trans: The head chef developed a new menu.
She works as an executive chef in Moscow.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
